assets.name: advance
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Paint a production 2D Chinese fantasy game animation atlas with TRUE alpha transparency. The reference is ONLY character identity/color/style, NOT the layout. Sun Wukong: monkey face, golden filigree armor, flowing red scarf and waist sashes, thick teal trouser legs, gold boots, curved long head plumes and monkey tail. Same detailed painterly style and identity. CRITICAL layout: exactly EIGHT complete figures in TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS. Each of the eight rectangular cells is TWICE AS WIDE as it is tall. These extra-wide cells provide space for the long staff! Keep EACH entire character and entire straight staff in its own cell with 12 percent transparent gap at all cell edges. No overlap with neighbors. Each figure includes complete connected head, torso, hips, BOTH arms and hands, BOTH legs and feet, whole clothes and staff. Full body integrally painted in each frame, no paper doll. Same side-view camera, scale and floor at 86 percent cell height. All generally face RIGHT. The one long straight slim gold-banded dark brown staff is TWICE anatomical head-to-foot body height; all of it including both ends stays inside each EXTRA-WIDE cell. The head-to-foot body height is about 53 percent of cell height, plumes make the whole silhouette about 74 percent. Staff held naturally with both hands and elbows articulated, large real martial body/waist/shoulder actions. One rigid continuous staff, no disconnected section, no second stick, no gun aiming. Eight key poses form ONE chronological fluid staff attack sequence with clear anticipation, exertion and recovery. Red cloth and plumes follow the changing torso rotation. No scenery, shadows, border, grid, text, labels, letters, glow, motion trails, blur, extra limbs. 2048x2048 preferred. Action is a FORCEFUL FORWARD CIRCULAR STAFF SWEEP with a long reach and broad whole-body lunge. EXACTLY eight consecutive poses in TWO COLUMNS FOUR ROWS, not 16. Frame1 diagonal ready guard, body facing right. Frame2 take a small forward step, twist chest back and draw the shaft diagonally up behind shoulder in a deep coil. Frame3 torso turned away three-quarter BACK, staff passes almost horizontally BEHIND the shoulders, coiled front knee. Frame4 hips turn toward RIGHT, staff sweeps forward chest-height, both elbows extend as the front foot plants. Frame5 strongest fully extended forward HORIZONTAL SWING to RIGHT: very broad natural lunge with front knee bent and rear leg extended, torso leaning into force; both arms stretched away from chest, hands hold the REAR THIRD of the whole straight staff so its long forward end projects FAR ahead of the body. Frame6 follow-through diagonally down-forward to RIGHT, shoulders lower, rear foot follows. Frame7 draw the staff back diagonally upward with weight settling. Frame8 recover to the SAME relaxed diagonal guard as frame1. Clearly distinct weapon directions and full-body silhouettes at each step. This is a sweeping club motion, never a rifle or spear shooting pose. There must be plenty of empty horizontal room for the FULL LONG STAFF in every wide cell, no part of the weapon or plumes touching any neighboring character. Keep anatomical head and torso size consistent across all eight drawings.

assets.name: ruyiStaff
assets.prompt: Use case: game-asset. ONE SINGLE COMPLETE straight Ruyi Jingu Bang weapon, Sun Wukong's long staff, isolated horizontally left-to-right on genuine transparent alpha background. Match a detailed painterly Chinese fantasy 2D side-scrolling game, antique gold armor style. Long slender dark mahogany-brown metal/wood shaft with warm gold highlights, subtle continuous engraved golden dragons and cloud motifs, ornate GOLD METAL END CAPS at BOTH ends each taking about 12 percent of total length, slimmer decorative golden rings between cap and shaft. The pole must be one perfectly STRAIGHT CONTINUOUS SOLID piece, no gaps, no joints jutting out, no detached part, no handle, no hands, no holder, no characters. Almost full image width with 8 percent transparent left/right margins. Total width-to-thickness ratio about 55 to 1: elegant martial staff, not a chunky club or sword. Both ends same modest rounded thickness, gold cap only about 1.4 times shaft diameter. Top-left soft game-art light, detailed gold relief and readable warm woody shaft, keep it crisp with unbroken silhouette. NO scenery, background, ground, shadow, text, logo, border, glow, sparks, trails, blur, bent staff or extra weapons. Wide landscape asset, 1536 by 256 preferred.
